- Arrival times: most of the group land between 5:30–6:15pm. We expect to start dinner 7:00pm.
- Transportation: a pair of town cars for airport pickups would be helpful (4 pax each), plus a ride for our advisor arriving earlier.

Can your team confirm caterer options and whether Redwood can handle the pickups / short car service? I can loop in our event contact if helpful.

AmpliTech
